requirement: Collect, organize, and analyze full requirement list
description: Capture every explicit and implicit user requirement in a traceable inventory; organize by category; analyze for gaps and dependencies

requirement: Suggestions to improve site for decision making
description: Generate concrete, reviewable suggestions that would improve decision quality if implemented
Publish a standalone section where suggestions can be reviewed and selected before any change is applied

requirement: Clear list of questions / informations / answers before any decision
description: Provide Q/I/A ledger stating what must be known, what we have, what is missing, before a reasonable decision
Each missing-info item includes a suggestion for how to discover it without hallucination
Research and specify a method to originate spread / moneyline / total / player-prop lines from first-principle team and player models
Develop frozen candidate strategies that could generate useful signals; treat as hypotheses not proven edges
Design a leaderboard that only ranks all-gate qualifiers; rewards are non-monetary research priority, not payout

requirement: Markets: single bet, parlays, player-prop combos
description: Cover L1 singles, X1/X2 parlays, P1/C1 player-prop and prop-combo markets with explicit rules
Enforce 10 gates (rights, provenance, chronology, sample/precision, calibration, ROI, CLV, multiplicity, dependence, ledger) — all must pass
Compute Pearson/phi from training-only paired residuals; retain zeros; slate-clustered CI; joint sample required for combos
Rank by lower bound of clustered holdout ROI, Bonferroni multiplicity control, proper-score improvement; acknowledge luck cannot be eliminated
System must ingest timestamped official injury report and detect when 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups replace starters on offense and defense
Provide a concise, source-linked summary of status, boundaries, and open items
Site and data are static, pre-generated; no user input field is required to view findings

requirement: Repo review line-by-line with verified trusted sources
description: Review every repo line against official host; provide links for manual review; flag irregularities; no hallucinations

requirement: Every table row has official source link; unverified blank and flagged
description: If a value cannot be confirmed from an official source, leave blank and flag as unverified; never infer
